programme.title: E7 - Elephants Pt2 Across Borders
programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. It’s a 50-hour non-stop drive from South Africa to Mozambique. The team must arrive at Zinave National Park before sunset on day 2 to safely offload the elephants. However, a late departure and unexpected delays at the borders means they could be facing offloading the elephants under only the light of the moon. Not ideal for the exhausted drivers and the wild elephants who are ready to get out of their transportation crates and explore their new home.

programme.title: E8 - Air Horse One
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. programme.title: Legacy Of Rage
programme.desc: Brandon Ma, a regular guy working in Hong Kong, who is set up by his drug-dealing best friend Michael, to take the rap for the murder of an undercover cop. Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge...

programme.title: Security Unlimited
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.title: Hong Kong 1941
programme.desc: The story is set against the backdrop of Hong Kong in 1941. Fai, a young man who's trying to scrape up enough money to catch a boat to the U.S. He befriends Kong, who comes from a wealthy family but now works as a coolie working for a successful rice merchant. Kong's childhood friend, Anna who is betrothed to a man by her politically ambitions father. The trio decides to make a run for the boat but on the day of their planned escape, the war breaks out and they are forced to stay behind. Fai signs up to work for the enemy to help Kong and Anna in their next attempt to escape...

E21
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.title: E21
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs.
